ysĠthatĠafterĠtheĠsemicolon,ĠIĠshouldĠreturnĠtheĠboundĠnameĠitself,ĠwhichĠinĠthisĠcaseĠisĠ`f`,ĠbutĠthatĠwouldĠrequireĠanĠadditionalĠ`;Ġf`,ĠwhichĠseemsĠredundant.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠIĠshouldĠfollowĠtheĠoriginalĠexampleĠandĠincludeĠbothĠtheĠletĠbindingĠandĠthenĠtheĠfunctionĠcall.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠfinalĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊ```ĊletĠfĠ=Ġ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>ĠxĠ+Ġy;ĠfĊ```ĊĊButĠaccordingĠtoĠtheĠrules,ĠIĠshouldĠwriteĠtheĠright-handĠsideĠimmediatelyĠafterĠtheĠ`let`,ĠthenĠ`;`,ĠandĠthenĠtheĠfinalĠexpression.ĠSo,Ġyes,ĠthatĠmakesĠsense.Ċ

s:Ġ"ifĠtheĠprefixĠisĠinsideĠaĠ`let`Ġinitializer,ĠwriteĠtheĠinitializerĠvalueĠimmediately,ĠthenĠ`;`ĠandĠtheĠremainingĠstatements."ĠSo,ĠwithinĠtheĠifĠandĠelseĠblocks,ĠshouldĠIĠdeclareĠdĠwithĠtheĠvalue?ĊĊHmm,ĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠinitializeĠdĠwithinĠtheĠif-elseĠblocks.ĠButĠtheĠproblemĠalsoĠsaysĠtoĠdeclareĠvariablesĠbeforeĠuse.ĠWait,ĠdoesĠdĠneedĠtoĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠtheĠifĠstatement?ĠOrĠcanĠIĠdeclareĠitĠinsideĠtheĠif-else?ĊĊIĠthinkĠinĠimperativeĠprogramming,ĠvariablesĠmustĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠtheyĠareĠused.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠIĠshouldĠdeclareĠdĠbeforeĠtheĠifĠstatement.ĠLetĠmeĠadjust:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠd;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊWait,ĠdoesĠthatĠwork?ĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠredeclaringĠdĠinsideĠtheĠif-elseĠisĠallowed.ĠMaybeĠIĠshouldĠinitializeĠdĠsoĠthatĠit'sĠdeclaredĠonceĠbeforeĠtheĠifĠstatement.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠIĠcouldĠwriteĠitĠas:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠletĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠletĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊButĠIĠthinkĠinĠsomeĠlanguages,ĠredeclaringĠaĠvariableĠinsideĠaĠblockĠisĠallowed,ĠbutĠI'mĠnotĠcertain.ĠMaybeĠit'sĠbetterĠtoĠhaveĠdĠdeclaredĠoutside.ĠLetĠmeĠtryĠthat.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfullĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠd;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊButĠisĠthatĠacceptable?ĠTheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠ"declareĠvariablesĠbeforeĠuse,"ĠsoĠdĠisĠafterĠtheĠifĠstatement.ĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠthat'sĠcorrect.ĠMaybeĠdĠshouldĠbeĠdeclaredĠbefore.ĊĊPerhapsĠIĠneedĠtoĠinitializeĠdĠtoĠaĠdefaultĠvalueĠfirst.ĠButĠtheĠproblemĠdoesn'tĠspecifyĠanyĠinitialĠvalueĠforĠd,ĠsoĠmaybeĠit'sĠokayĠtoĠhaveĠitĠdeclaredĠafterĠtheĠifĠstatement.ĠOrĠmaybeĠIĠshouldĠassignĠitĠaĠdefaultĠvalueĠlikeĠ0ĠbeforeĠtheĠifĠstatement.ĊĊWait,ĠletĠmeĠthinkĠagain.ĠTheĠproblemĠsays:Ġ"declareĠvariablesĠbeforeĠuse."ĠSo,ĠdĠisĠusedĠinĠtheĠifĠstatement,ĠwhichĠisĠafterĠtheĠdeclarationĠofĠaĠandĠb.ĠTherefore,ĠdĠmustĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠtheĠifĠstatement.ĠSo,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠdeclareĠdĠbeforeĠtheĠif-elseĠblock.ĊĊTherefore,ĠtheĠcorrectĠorderĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠd;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊYes,ĠthatĠmakesĠsense.ĠSo,ĠdĠisĠdeclaredĠafterĠaĠandĠb,ĠandĠthenĠinĠtheĠif-elseĠblock,ĠdĠisĠassignedĠaĠvalue.ĠButĠwait,ĠinĠimperativeĠprogramming,ĠcanĠyouĠhaveĠaĠvariableĠdeclaredĠafterĠitsĠusage?ĠOrĠmustĠitĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠit'sĠused?ĊĊIĠthinkĠinĠmostĠlanguages,ĠvariablesĠmustĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠtheyĠareĠused.ĠSo,ĠinĠthisĠcase,ĠdĠisĠusedĠinĠtheĠif-elseĠblock,ĠwhichĠisĠafterĠtheĠdeclarationĠofĠaĠandĠb.ĠTherefore,ĠdĠmustĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠtheĠif-elseĠblock.ĊĊButĠhow?ĠIfĠIĠdeclareĠdĠrightĠafter,Ġit'sĠinsideĠtheĠif-elseĠblock.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠIĠneedĠtoĠdeclareĠdĠbeforeĠtheĠif-else,ĠassignĠitĠappropriately,ĠandĠthenĠuseĠit.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠIĠcanĠinitializeĠdĠasĠ0,ĠthenĠinĠtheĠif-else,ĠassignĠitĠtheĠdifference.ĠButĠtheĠproblemĠmightĠnotĠrequireĠthat,ĠbutĠtheĠinitializersĠareĠpreferredĠtoĠbeĠsimpleĠintegersĠunlessĠspecifiedĠotherwise.ĊĊWait,ĠletĠmeĠsee.ĠTheĠproblemĠsays:Ġ"WorkĠprefersĠsimpleĠintegerĠliteralsĠforĠinitializersĠunlessĠtheĠtaskĠexplicitlyĠasksĠforĠaĠcomputedĠinitializer."ĊĊSo,ĠinitializingĠdĠtoĠ0ĠisĠaĠsimpleĠinteger.ĠButĠtheĠtaskĠisĠnotĠspecificallyĠaskingĠforĠaĠcomputedĠinitializer,ĠjustĠtoĠstoreĠtheĠabsoluteĠdifference.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠIĠcanĠinitializeĠdĠtoĠ0,ĠthenĠinĠtheĠif-else,ĠreassignĠit.ĠButĠthatĠwouldĠrequireĠwriting:ĊĊletĠdĠ=Ġ0;ĊĊButĠthenĠinĠtheĠif-else,Ġit'sĠredefined,ĠwhichĠmightĠnotĠbeĠideal.ĠAlternatively,ĠjustĠdeclareĠdĠbeforeĠtheĠif-else.ĊĊIĠthinkĠtheĠcorrectĠapproachĠisĠtoĠdeclareĠdĠbeforeĠusingĠit.ĠSo,ĠI'llĠhaveĠletĠd;ĠbeforeĠtheĠif-elseĠblock.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠd;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊButĠwait,ĠisĠthatĠallowedĠinĠtheĠlanguage?ĠBecauseĠdĠisĠdeclaredĠafter,ĠbutĠusedĠinĠtheĠif-else.ĠI'mĠnotĠsure.ĠMaybeĠinĠsomeĠlanguagesĠyouĠcanĠredeclareĠvariables,ĠbutĠinĠothers,ĠyouĠcan't.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠIĠcanĠinitializeĠdĠtoĠ0Ġfirst,ĠthenĠproceed:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠdĠ=Ġ0;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠ"don'tĠwriteĠbareĠidentifiersĠasĠstatements,"ĠsoĠIĠthinkĠusingĠdĠ=Ġ0ĠisĠacceptable.ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠpreferĠsimpleĠintegerĠliteralsĠforĠinitializersĠunlessĠspecified,ĠsoĠinitializingĠdĠtoĠ0ĠisĠacceptable.ĊĊButĠwait,ĠtheĠtaskĠisĠtoĠ"storeĠtheĠabsoluteĠdifferenceĠbetweenĠaĠandĠbĠintoĠd."ĠSo,ĠdoesĠdĠhaveĠtoĠbeĠassignedĠinĠaĠwayĠthatĠcomputesĠtheĠabsoluteĠvalue,ĠorĠisĠinitializingĠdĠtoĠ0ĠandĠthenĠreassigningĠitĠokay?ĊĊIĠthinkĠit'sĠacceptable,ĠbecauseĠtheĠtaskĠdoesn'tĠspecifyĠinitializingĠdĠinĠaĠparticularĠway,ĠjustĠstoringĠtheĠabsoluteĠdifference.ĠSo,ĠinitializingĠdĠtoĠ0ĠandĠthenĠsettingĠdĠtoĠtheĠabsoluteĠdifferenceĠisĠfine.ĊĊButĠtheĠproblemĠalsoĠsays:Ġ"declareĠvariablesĠbeforeĠuse,"ĠsoĠdĠisĠusedĠinĠtheĠstatements,ĠsoĠitĠmustĠbeĠdeclaredĠbefore.ĊĊTherefore,ĠtheĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠdĠ=Ġ0;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊYes,ĠthatĠshouldĠwork.ĊĊButĠletĠmeĠcheckĠifĠtheĠinitializersĠareĠwrittenĠimmediatelyĠifĠinsideĠaĠlet.ĠWait,ĠinĠtheĠifĠblock,Ġit'sĠinsideĠcurlyĠbraces,ĠsoĠdoĠIĠneedĠtoĠwriteĠtheĠletĠstatementĠimmediately?ĊĊTheĠproblemĠsays:Ġ"ifĠtheĠprefixĠisĠinsideĠaĠ`let`Ġinitializer,ĠwriteĠtheĠinitializerĠvalueĠimmediately,ĠthenĠ`;`ĠandĠtheĠremainingĠstatements."ĊĊSo,ĠinĠtheĠifĠblock,ĠisĠtheĠdeclarationĠofĠdĠconsideredĠaĠletĠinitializer?ĠOrĠisĠitĠaĠseparateĠletĠstatementĠoutside?ĠIĠthinkĠit'sĠaĠseparateĠletĠstatement,ĠsoĠitĠdoesn'tĠneedĠtoĠbeĠwrittenĠimmediately.ĊĊTherefore,ĠtheĠcodeĠIĠhaveĠshouldĠbeĠcorrect.ĊĊButĠtoĠmakeĠsure,ĠletĠmeĠstructureĠitĠproperly.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfinalĠprogramĠis:ĊĊletĠaĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠbĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠdĠ=Ġ0;ĊĊifĠ(aĠ>Ġb)Ġ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠaĠ-Ġb;Ċ}ĠelseĠ{ĊĠĠĠĠdĠ=ĠbĠ-Ġa;Ċ}ĊĊYes,ĠthatĠshouldĠdoĠit.Ċ

pleĠgiven,ĠtheĠ`let`ĠbindingĠisĠusedĠtoĠassignĠaĠfunctionĠtoĠaĠvariable,ĠandĠthatĠvariableĠisĠthenĠtheĠresult.ĊĊWait,ĠlookingĠbackĠatĠtheĠexample,ĠtheĠ`let`ĠexpressionĠisĠused,ĠandĠtheĠright-handĠsideĠisĠaĠfunction.ĠTheĠfinalĠexpressionĠafterĠtheĠsemicolonĠisĠtheĠboundĠname,ĠwhichĠinĠtheĠexampleĠisĠ`sqrt`.ĠSoĠinĠmyĠcase,ĠIĠthinkĠIĠneedĠtoĠhaveĠaĠ`let`ĠthatĠdefinesĠtheĠfunctionĠandĠthenĠthat'sĠtheĠfinalĠexpression.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠIĠthinkĠtheĠsolutionĠis:ĊĊ`letĠfĠ=Ġ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>ĠxĠ*Ġx;`ĊĊOr,ĠifĠusingĠfloat:ĊĊ`letĠfĠ=Ġ(x:Ġfloat)Ġ=>ĠxĠ*Ġx;`ĊĊButĠtheĠtypeĠisn'tĠspecifiedĠinĠtheĠquestion,ĠsoĠperhapsĠIĠcanĠleaveĠitĠasĠ`int`ĠbyĠdefault.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠshouldĠIĠspecifyĠtheĠtype?ĠTheĠproblemĠsaysĠthatĠtheĠfunctionĠshouldĠreturnĠtheĠfunctionĠasĠtheĠfinalĠexpression,ĠsoĠmaybeĠIĠdon'tĠneedĠtoĠcallĠit,ĠjustĠdefineĠit.ĊĊIĠthinkĠtheĠkeyĠisĠtoĠwriteĠtheĠ`let`ĠbindingĠforĠtheĠfunctionĠwithoutĠneedingĠtoĠassignĠitĠtoĠaĠvariableĠunlessĠrequiredĠbyĠtheĠlanguage.ĠButĠaccordingĠtoĠtheĠrules,ĠafterĠtheĠsemicolon,ĠtheĠboundĠnameĠisĠreturned.ĠSoĠIĠneedĠtoĠhaveĠtheĠ`let`ĠbindingĠbeĠtheĠfinalĠexpression.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠstructureĠwouldĠbeĠ`letĠfĠ=Ġ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>ĠxĠ*Ġx;`ĠasĠtheĠfinalĠline.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠinĠtheĠexampleĠgiven,ĠtheĠ`let`ĠisĠtheĠtop-levelĠstatement,ĠandĠtheĠright-handĠsideĠisĠtheĠexpressionĠtoĠbeĠevaluated,ĠthenĠtheĠboundĠnameĠisĠreturned.ĠSoĠyes,ĠthatĠshouldĠwork.ĊĊLetĠmeĠdouble-checkĠtheĠrules:ĠIfĠtheĠprefixĠisĠaĠ`let`ĠbindingĠendingĠwithĠ`=`,ĠwriteĠtheĠright-handĠsideĠimmediately,ĠthenĠ`;`ĠandĠtheĠrequestedĠfinalĠexpression.ĠSoĠtheĠright-handĠsideĠisĠtheĠexpressionĠtoĠbeĠbound,ĠandĠafterĠtheĠsemicolon,ĠtheĠboundĠnameĠisĠreturned.ĊĊSoĠinĠthisĠcase,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠwriteĠ`letĠfĠ=Ġ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>ĠxĠ*Ġx;`ĠasĠtheĠfinalĠexpression.ĠThatĠshouldĠdefineĠ`f`ĠasĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠanĠintegerĠandĠreturnsĠitsĠsquare,ĠandĠthenĠ`f`ĠisĠreturnedĠasĠtheĠresult.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠifĠIĠuseĠ`float`,ĠitĠwouldĠbeĠ`floatĠ->Ġfloat`,ĠbutĠsinceĠtheĠproblemĠdoesn'tĠspecify,ĠI'llĠassumeĠ`int`ĠisĠfine.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfinalĠanswerĠshouldĠbe:ĊĊ`letĠfĠ=Ġ(x:Ġint)Ġ=>ĠxĠ*Ġx;`Ċ

rĠsumming,ĠsoĠIĠthinkĠanĠ`if`ĠstatementĠisĠunnecessary.ĠUnlessĠtheĠtaskĠimpliesĠaĠconditionalĠexecution,ĠbutĠtheĠproblemĠisĠsimplyĠtoĠstoreĠtheĠsumĠregardlessĠofĠanything,ĠsoĠmaybeĠaĠ`while`ĠloopĠisĠoverkill.ĠMaybeĠaĠsimpleĠstatementĠlikeĠ`whileĠtrueĠ{ĠtotalĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;Ġ}`ĠwouldĠwork,ĠbutĠthat'sĠanĠinfiniteĠloop.ĊĊWait,ĠtheĠtaskĠisĠtoĠstoreĠtheĠsum,ĠnotĠtoĠdoĠsomethingĠrepeatedly.ĠSo,ĠperhapsĠaĠsimpleĠstatementĠisĠenough.ĠButĠdoĠIĠneedĠtoĠuseĠbraces?ĠLetĠmeĠcheckĠtheĠgrammar.ĠTheĠstatementsĠincludeĠif,Ġwhile,Ġetc.,ĠeachĠwithĠtheirĠownĠblocks.ĠSo,ĠIĠshouldĠuseĠcurlyĠbracesĠtoĠencloseĠtheĠbody.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠsumĠstatementĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊwhileĠcondĠ{ĠtotalĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;Ġ}ĊĊButĠwait,ĠinĠthisĠcase,Ġit'sĠjustĠassigningĠtheĠsum.ĠAlternatively,ĠIĠcanĠjustĠhaveĠaĠsingleĠstatement:ĊĊtotalĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊButĠsinceĠweĠneedĠtoĠuseĠaĠloop,ĠmaybeĠtheĠtaskĠimpliesĠsomeĠrepetition,ĠbutĠit'sĠnotĠclear.ĠTheĠproblemĠstatementĠjustĠsaysĠtoĠstoreĠtheĠsum,ĠnotĠtoĠdoĠanythingĠinĠaĠloop.ĊĊWait,ĠtheĠuserĠsaysĠ"storeĠtheĠsumĠintoĠtotal."ĠSo,ĠmaybeĠaĠsingleĠstatementĠisĠsufficient.ĠSo,ĠtheĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠa:ĠIntĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠb:ĠIntĠ=Ġ3;ĊtotalĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠ`total`ĠneedsĠtoĠbeĠdeclaredĠbeforeĠuse.ĠTheĠproblemĠsaysĠtoĠdeclareĠtheĠrequiredĠresultĠvariableĠwithĠ`letĠname:ĠTypeĠ=Ġexpr;`,ĠsoĠIĠshouldĠdeclareĠ`total`ĠasĠwell.ĊĊSo,ĠI'llĠadd:ĊĊletĠtotal:ĠIntĠ=Ġ0;ĊĊButĠthen,ĠafterĠinitializingĠaĠandĠb,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠassignĠtheĠsumĠtoĠtotal.ĠSo,ĠmaybeĠtheĠprogramĠshouldĠlookĠlike:ĊĊletĠa:ĠIntĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠb:ĠIntĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠtotal:ĠIntĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊButĠtheĠtaskĠsaysĠ"storeĠtheĠsumĠintoĠtotal,"ĠsoĠthisĠmightĠbeĠsufficient.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠifĠIĠwantĠtoĠuseĠaĠblock,ĠIĠcanĠwrite:ĊĊtotal:ĠIntĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠthat'sĠtheĠcorrectĠsyntax.ĊĊWait,ĠtheĠgrammarĠincludes:ĊĊ-ĠStatements:ĠletĠx:Int=expr;ĠorĠBool,ĠassignmentĠx=expr;,Ġif(cond){...}ĠelseĠ{...},ĠandĠwhile(cond){...}.ĊĊ-ĠExpressionsĠincludeĠintegers,Ġbooleans,Ġvariables,ĠIntĠarithmeticĠ+,Ġ-,Ġ*,Ġ/,ĠandĠIntĠcomparisonsĠ==,Ġ!=,Ġ<,Ġ>,ĠreturningĠBool.ĊĊSo,ĠanĠassignmentĠstatementĠisĠx=expr,ĠwhichĠcanĠbeĠaĠsimpleĠassignmentĠorĠaĠcomputation.ĊĊTherefore,ĠtheĠsumĠstatementĠcanĠbeĠwrittenĠas:ĊĊtotalĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠcompleteĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠa:ĠIntĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠb:ĠIntĠ=Ġ3;ĊtotalĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠaccordingĠtoĠtheĠuser'sĠinstruction,ĠifĠtheĠprefixĠisĠinsideĠaĠ`let`Ġinitializer,ĠwriteĠtheĠinitializerĠvalueĠimmediately,ĠthenĠsemicolon,ĠandĠtheĠremainingĠstatements.ĠSo,ĠmaybeĠIĠshouldĠwriteĠtheĠ`let`ĠstatementsĠforĠaĠandĠbĠtogether,ĠbutĠI'mĠnotĠsure.ĠLetĠmeĠthink.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠIĠshouldĠwriteĠtheĠprogramĠas:ĊĊletĠa:ĠIntĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠb:ĠIntĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠtotal:ĠIntĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠthat'sĠnecessary.ĠTheĠuser'sĠinstructionĠsaysĠthatĠifĠtheĠprefixĠisĠinsideĠaĠ`let`Ġinitializer,ĠwriteĠtheĠinitializerĠvalueĠimmediately.ĠSo,ĠifĠIĠcanĠincludeĠbothĠaĠandĠbĠinĠaĠsingleĠ`let`Ġstatement,ĠthatĠwouldĠbeĠbetter.ĠLetĠmeĠcheckĠtheĠgrammarĠagain.ĊĊTheĠgrammarĠincludesĠ`letĠx:Int=expr;`ĠorĠ`x=expr;`.ĠSo,Ġpossibly,ĠeachĠ`let`ĠisĠaĠseparateĠstatement.ĠTherefore,ĠIĠshouldĠwriteĠseparateĠ`let`ĠstatementsĠforĠa,Ġb,ĠandĠtotal.ĊĊButĠtheĠuserĠalsoĠmentionsĠthatĠwhenĠtheĠprefixĠisĠinsideĠaĠ`let`Ġinitializer,ĠIĠshouldĠwriteĠtheĠinitializerĠvalueĠimmediately,ĠthenĠaĠsemicolon,ĠandĠtheĠremainingĠstatements.ĠSo,ĠmaybeĠifĠIĠcanĠwriteĠaĠandĠbĠinĠoneĠ`let`,ĠthenĠtheĠinitializerĠwouldĠincludeĠtheĠassignmentsĠforĠaĠandĠb.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠtheĠgivenĠgrammarĠallowsĠforĠmultipleĠ`let`Ġstatements.ĠSo,ĠIĠthinkĠit'sĠacceptableĠtoĠwriteĠseparateĠ`let`ĠdeclarationsĠforĠa,Ġb,ĠandĠtotal.ĊĊPuttingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠprogramĠshouldĠdeclareĠaĠandĠb,ĠassignĠthemĠintegerĠvalues,ĠandĠthenĠassignĠtheirĠsumĠtoĠtotal.ĠSo,ĠtheĠfinalĠprogramĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠa:ĠIntĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠb:ĠIntĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠtotal:ĠIntĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊButĠwait,ĠdoesĠthisĠsatisfyĠtheĠuser'sĠinstructionĠaboutĠtheĠprefix?ĠTheĠinstructionĠsays:Ġ"ifĠtheĠprefixĠisĠinsideĠaĠ`let`Ġinitializer,ĠwriteĠtheĠinitializerĠvalueĠimmediately,ĠthenĠsemicolon,ĠandĠtheĠremainingĠstatements."ĊĊIĠthinkĠIĠinterpretedĠthatĠcorrectlyĠbyĠwritingĠseparateĠ`let`Ġstatements.ĠAlternatively,ĠifĠIĠcanĠwriteĠaĠsingleĠ`let`ĠstatementĠthatĠdeclaresĠandĠinitializesĠaĠandĠb,ĠbutĠIĠthinkĠthat'sĠnotĠpossibleĠwithĠtheĠgivenĠgrammar.ĠSo,Ġit'sĠbetterĠtoĠwriteĠseparateĠ`let`Ġstatements.ĊĊAlso,ĠtheĠuserĠsaysĠtoĠavoidĠwritingĠbareĠidentifiersĠasĠstatements,ĠbutĠinĠtheĠassignmentĠstatements,Ġit'sĠallowedĠsinceĠtheyĠareĠpartĠofĠexpressionsĠorĠassignments.ĊĊSo,ĠIĠthinkĠtheĠprogramĠshouldĠbe:ĊĊletĠa:ĠIntĠ=Ġ5;ĊletĠb:ĠIntĠ=Ġ3;ĊletĠtotal:ĠIntĠ=ĠaĠ+Ġb;ĊĊThat'sĠtheĠminimalĠprogramĠthatĠsatisfiesĠtheĠtask.Ċ

t,ĠthenĠtheĠsecond,ĠthenĠtheĠfirst.ĠSoĠtheĠfunctionsĠareĠappliedĠinĠtheĠorderĠh,ĠthenĠg,ĠthenĠf.ĠButĠeachĠapplicationĠstepĠproducesĠaĠvalueĠthatĠisĠtheĠresultĠofĠtheĠpreviousĠfunction.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠtermĠshouldĠbeĠhĠappliedĠtoĠx,ĠthenĠgĠappliedĠtoĠthatĠresult,ĠthenĠfĠappliedĠtoĠtheĠfinalĠresult.ĊĊInĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠthisĠwouldĠbeĠwrittenĠasĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĠButĠletĠmeĠmakeĠsureĠaboutĠtheĠtypes.ĊĊEachĠfunctionĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt,ĠsoĠapplyingĠhĠtoĠxĠ(aĠBool)ĠgivesĠanĠInt,ĠwhichĠisĠthenĠpassedĠtoĠg,ĠwhichĠreturnsĠaĠBool,ĠandĠthenĠthatĠBoolĠisĠpassedĠtoĠf,ĠwhichĠreturnsĠanĠInt.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠfĠisĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt,ĠsoĠfĠexpectsĠaĠBool,ĠbutĠtheĠresultĠofĠgĠisĠaĠBool.ĠSoĠthat'sĠcorrect.ĊĊSoĠtheĠoverallĠtermĠisĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĠButĠinĠlambdaĠcalculusĠnotation,ĠthisĠisĠwrittenĠasĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊButĠIĠneedĠtoĠrepresentĠthisĠasĠaĠsingleĠlambdaĠterm.ĠSinceĠtheĠtermĠtakesĠfourĠargumentsĠinĠaĠcertainĠorder,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠstructureĠitĠaccordingly.ĊĊWait,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠsupposedĠtoĠtakeĠf,Ġg,Ġh,ĠandĠx.ĠSoĠfĠisĠofĠtypeĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt,ĠgĠisĠIntĠâĨĴĠBool,ĠhĠisĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt,ĠandĠxĠisĠBool.ĊĊSoĠtheĠtermĠshouldĠbeĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠf,ĠthenĠg,ĠthenĠh,ĠthenĠx,ĠandĠappliesĠthemĠinĠtheĠorderĠh,ĠthenĠg,ĠthenĠf.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠhĠx,ĠthenĠgĠappliedĠtoĠthat,ĠthenĠfĠappliedĠtoĠthat.ĠSoĠtheĠfullĠtermĠisĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊButĠwait,ĠinĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠfunctionĠapplicationĠisĠleft-associative,ĠsoĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx))ĠisĠtheĠsameĠasĠ(fĠ(gĠ(hĠx))),ĠwhichĠisĠfĠappliedĠtoĠtheĠresultĠofĠgĠappliedĠtoĠhĠappliedĠtoĠx.ĊĊIĠthinkĠthat'sĠcorrect.ĠSoĠtheĠtermĠisĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊButĠsinceĠwe'reĠusingĠtheĠsimplyĠtypedĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠensureĠthatĠtheĠtypesĠareĠcorrectlyĠannotated.ĊĊSo,ĠinĠtermsĠofĠtheĠsyntax,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊfĠ(gĠ(hĠx))ĊĊButĠinĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠthisĠwouldĠbeĠrepresentedĠasĠ(fĠ(gĠ(hĠx))).ĠHowever,ĠsinceĠfunctionĠapplicationĠisĠleft-associative,Ġit'sĠequivalent.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠtoĠmakeĠitĠexplicit,ĠitĠcouldĠbeĠwrittenĠasĠ((fĠâĪĺĠg)ĠâĪĺĠh)Ġx,ĠbutĠperhapsĠit'sĠsufficientĠtoĠwriteĠitĠasĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊWait,Ġno,Ġthat'sĠnotĠquiteĠright.ĠBecauseĠfunctionĠcompositionĠwouldĠrequireĠtheĠtypesĠtoĠmatch.ĠForĠexample,ĠfĠisĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt,ĠgĠisĠIntĠâĨĴĠBool,ĠhĠisĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt.ĠSo,ĠifĠIĠdoĠhĠx,ĠwhichĠisĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt,ĠthenĠgĠ(hĠx)ĠwouldĠbeĠIntĠâĨĴĠBool,ĠandĠthenĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx))ĠwouldĠbeĠBoolĠâĨĴĠInt.ĊĊWait,Ġno,Ġthat'sĠnotĠcorrect.ĠBecauseĠgĠ(hĠx)ĠwouldĠbeĠgĠappliedĠtoĠhĠx,ĠwhichĠisĠ(IntĠâĨĴĠBool)Ġ(hĠxĠ:ĠInt),ĠresultingĠinĠBool.ĠThenĠfĠappliedĠtoĠthatĠBoolĠwouldĠgiveĠInt.ĊĊWait,ĠperhapsĠI'mĠovercomplicatingĠit.ĠLetĠmeĠtryĠtoĠbreakĠitĠdownĠagain.ĊĊTheĠfunctionsĠare:ĊĊ-Ġf:ĠBoolĠâĨĴĠIntĊ-Ġg:ĠIntĠâĨĴĠBoolĊ-Ġh:ĠBoolĠâĨĴĠIntĊ-Ġx:ĠBoolĊĊWeĠneedĠtoĠapplyĠhĠfirst,ĠthenĠg,ĠthenĠf.ĊĊSo,Ġh(x)ĠisĠInt.ĠThen,Ġg(h(x))ĠisĠBool.ĠThen,Ġf(g(h(x)))ĠisĠInt.ĊĊSoĠtheĠtermĠisĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊYes,ĠthatĠmakesĠsense.ĊĊButĠsinceĠtheĠtaskĠspecifiesĠthatĠtheĠlambdaĠtermĠshouldĠtakeĠtheseĠfourĠarguments,ĠIĠthinkĠIĠneedĠtoĠstructureĠitĠasĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠf,ĠthenĠg,ĠthenĠh,ĠthenĠx,ĠandĠappliesĠthemĠinĠtheĠspecifiedĠorder.ĊĊSoĠtheĠlambdaĠtermĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊfĠ(gĠ(hĠx))ĊĊButĠinĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠfunctionsĠareĠwrittenĠasĠÎ»x.M,ĠsoĠtoĠrepresentĠtakingĠmultipleĠarguments,ĠIĠneedĠtoĠnestĠtheĠlambdas.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbe:ĠÎ»f.Ġ(Î»g.Ġ(Î»h.Ġ(Î»x.ĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx))))).ĊĊWait,Ġno.ĠLetĠmeĠthinkĠagain.ĊĊEachĠlambdaĠtakesĠaĠsingleĠargument.ĠSo,ĠtoĠtakeĠmultipleĠarguments,ĠIĠnestĠtheĠlambdas.ĊĊSo,ĠstartingĠfromĠtheĠinnermost,ĠxĠisĠaĠBool.ĠThenĠhĠtakesĠx,ĠreturnsĠInt.ĠThenĠgĠtakesĠthatĠInt,ĠreturnsĠBool.ĠThenĠfĠtakesĠthatĠBool,ĠreturnsĠInt.ĊĊSoĠtheĠstructureĠisĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)),ĠwhichĠcanĠbeĠwrittenĠasĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊButĠsinceĠfĠexpectsĠaĠBool,ĠgĠ(hĠx)ĠmustĠreturnĠaĠBool,ĠwhichĠitĠdoesĠbecauseĠg:ĠIntĠâĨĴĠBoolĠandĠhĠx:ĠInt.ĊĊSo,ĠputtingĠitĠallĠtogether,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)).ĊĊButĠIĠneedĠtoĠrepresentĠthisĠasĠaĠlambdaĠtermĠthatĠtakesĠf,Ġg,Ġh,ĠxĠinĠthatĠorderĠandĠappliesĠthemĠinĠtheĠsequenceĠh,Ġg,Ġf.ĊĊSo,ĠinĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbe:ĊĊ(Î»f.Ġ(Î»g.Ġ(Î»h.Ġ(Î»x.ĠfĠ(gĠ(hĠx)))))).ĊĊWait,ĠthatĠseemsĠaĠb takesĠf,Ġg,ĠandĠaĠasĠarguments.Ċ2.ĠSo,ĠtheĠtermĠwillĠbeĠsomethingĠlikeĠfĠ(gĠa)Ġ(a).Ċ3.ĠWait,ĠbutĠgĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠInt,ĠandĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠInt,ĠsoĠapplyingĠfĠtoĠtheseĠtwoĠshouldĠgiveĠmeĠaĠBool.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠfĠexpectsĠanĠIntĠandĠthenĠanotherĠInt.ĠSoĠmaybeĠIĠshouldĠstructureĠitĠasĠfĠ(gĠa)Ġ(a).ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠthat'sĠtheĠcorrectĠwayĠtoĠapplyĠit.ĠLetĠmeĠthinkĠaboutĠtheĠtypesĠagain.ĊĊf:ĠIntĠ->ĠIntĠ->ĠBoolĊg:ĠBoolĠ->ĠIntĊa:ĠBoolĠ&ĠIntĊĊSo,ĠfĠexpectsĠtwoĠargumentsĠofĠInt.ĠButĠIĠhaveĠaĠBoolĠandĠanĠIntĠinĠa.ĠSoĠperhapsĠIĠneedĠtoĠextractĠtheĠIntĠpartĠfromĠaĠandĠuseĠitĠasĠtheĠsecondĠargumentĠtoĠf,ĠwhileĠtheĠfirstĠargumentĠcomesĠfromĠapplyingĠgĠtoĠtheĠBoolĠpartĠofĠa.ĊĊSo,ĠapplyingĠgĠtoĠa'sĠBoolĠgivesĠmeĠanĠInt,ĠwhichĠwouldĠbeĠtheĠfirstĠargumentĠtoĠf.ĠThen,ĠtheĠsecondĠargumentĠisĠa'sĠInt.ĊĊSoĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(gĠ(aBool))Ġ(aInt).ĠButĠsinceĠaĠisĠaĠpair,ĠmaybeĠIĠneedĠtoĠpatternĠmatchĠorĠsomething,ĠbutĠinĠSTLC,ĠweĠcan'tĠdoĠpatternĠmatchingĠdirectly.ĊĊWait,ĠmaybeĠI'mĠovercomplicatingĠit.ĠSinceĠaĠisĠaĠBoolĠ&ĠInt,ĠperhapsĠIĠcanĠthinkĠofĠitĠasĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠreturnsĠtwoĠvalues,ĠbutĠinĠSTLC,ĠweĠdon'tĠhaveĠproductĠtypes,ĠsoĠIĠmightĠneedĠtoĠrepresentĠitĠdifferently.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠtheĠfunctionĠaĠisĠexpectingĠaĠBoolĠandĠthenĠanĠInt,ĠbutĠinĠcurriedĠform,Ġit'sĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠanĠInt.ĊĊWait,Ġno,ĠtheĠuserĠsaysĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠBoolĠ&ĠInt,ĠwhichĠinĠSTLCĠwouldĠrequireĠaĠpairingĠtype,ĠbutĠsinceĠSTLCĠdoesn'tĠhaveĠproductĠtypes,ĠIĠmightĠneedĠtoĠuseĠaĠChurch-encodedĠpairĠorĠsomething.ĊĊButĠperhapsĠtheĠuserĠisĠsimplifyingĠit,ĠandĠaĠisĠjustĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠthenĠanĠInt,Ġi.e.,ĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠBoolĠ->ĠInt.ĊĊWait,ĠtheĠoriginalĠproblemĠsaysĠaĠisĠaĠBoolĠandĠanĠInt,ĠsoĠmaybeĠit'sĠaĠproductĠtype,ĠbutĠsinceĠwe'reĠworkingĠinĠSTLC,ĠwhichĠdoesn'tĠhaveĠproductĠtypes,ĠIĠmightĠneedĠtoĠencodeĠitĠusingĠfunctions.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠaĠisĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠthenĠanĠInt,ĠsoĠa:ĠBoolĠ->ĠInt.ĊĊWait,ĠIĠthinkĠI'mĠgettingĠconfusedĠhere.ĠLetĠmeĠtryĠtoĠrephraseĠtheĠproblem.ĊĊTheĠfunctionĠfĠtakesĠtwoĠIntsĠandĠreturnsĠaĠBool,ĠcurriedĠasĠIntĠ->ĠIntĠ->ĠBool.ĊĊTheĠfunctionĠgĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt.ĊĊWeĠhaveĠaĠvalueĠaĠwhichĠisĠaĠBoolĠandĠanĠInt,ĠsoĠperhapsĠaĠisĠaĠpair,ĠbutĠsinceĠSTLCĠdoesn'tĠhaveĠproductĠtypes,ĠaĠisĠrepresentedĠasĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠanĠInt.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠIĠneedĠtoĠwriteĠisĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠf,Ġg,ĠandĠa,ĠandĠthenĠappliesĠgĠtoĠa'sĠBoolĠtoĠgetĠanĠInt,ĠandĠthenĠappliesĠfĠtoĠthatĠresultĠalongĠwithĠa'sĠInt.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠfĠexpectsĠtwoĠInts,ĠsoĠapplyingĠfĠtoĠgĠaĠBoolĠandĠaĠIntĠwouldĠgiveĠmeĠaĠBool.ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠsureĠifĠthat'sĠtheĠcorrectĠwayĠtoĠstructureĠit.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠperhapsĠtheĠtermĠshouldĠbeĠfĠ(gĠa)Ġ(a),ĠwhereĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠBoolĠ->ĠInt,ĠsoĠgĠaĠisĠanĠInt,ĠandĠthenĠfĠisĠappliedĠtoĠthatĠIntĠandĠanotherĠIntĠ(fromĠa).ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠifĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠBoolĠ->ĠInt,ĠthenĠaĠBoolĠisĠanĠInt.ĠSoĠfĠexpectsĠtwoĠInts,ĠsoĠfĠ(gĠ(aĠBool))Ġ(aĠInt)ĠwouldĠbeĠfĠappliedĠtoĠgĠ(aĠBool)ĠasĠtheĠfirstĠargumentĠandĠaĠIntĠasĠtheĠsecond.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠifĠaĠisĠofĠtypeĠBoolĠ->ĠInt,ĠthenĠaĠBoolĠisĠanĠInt,ĠsoĠgĠ(aĠBool)ĠwouldĠbeĠgĠappliedĠtoĠanĠInt,ĠbutĠgĠexpectsĠaĠBool,ĠsoĠthatĠwouldn'tĠwork.ĊĊHmm,ĠperhapsĠI'mĠgettingĠstuckĠonĠtheĠtypes.ĊĊLetĠmeĠtryĠtoĠthinkĠdifferently.ĠMaybeĠaĠisĠaĠvalueĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠthenĠanĠInt,ĠsoĠit'sĠlikeĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠreturnsĠanĠIntĠwhenĠgivenĠaĠBool.ĊĊSo,ĠgĠisĠalsoĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt.ĠSoĠperhapsĠaĠandĠgĠareĠsimilarĠtypes.ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠtheĠproblemĠsaysĠaĠisĠaĠBoolĠ&ĠInt,ĠsoĠperhapsĠit'sĠaĠtuple,ĠbutĠinĠSTLC,ĠweĠdon'tĠhaveĠtuples.ĠSoĠaĠmightĠbeĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠanĠInt,ĠbecauseĠinĠcurriedĠform,ĠaĠBoolĠwouldĠgiveĠyouĠanĠInt.ĊĊWait,ĠthatĠmakesĠsense.ĠSoĠa:ĠBoolĠ->ĠInt.ĊĊSo,ĠgĠisĠalsoĠBoolĠ->ĠInt.ĠSoĠbothĠaĠandĠgĠareĠfunctionsĠthatĠtakeĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnĠanĠInt.ĊĊThen,ĠtheĠfunctionĠIĠneedĠtoĠwriteĠtakesĠf:ĠIntĠ->ĠIntĠ->ĠBool,Ġg:ĠBoolĠ->ĠInt,ĠandĠa:ĠBoolĠ->ĠInt.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbeĠfĠ(gĠa)Ġ(a).ĠWait,Ġ xĠyĠwouldĠbeĠ((fĠx)Ġy).ĊĊButĠinĠourĠcase,ĠfĠtakesĠthreeĠarguments,ĠsoĠit'sĠmoreĠlikeĠ(IntĠ.Ġ(BoolĠ.Ġ(IntĠ.Ġ(Î»x:ĠIntĠ.ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠ.ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠ.ĠyĠ))Ġ)).ĊĊSo,ĠIĠthinkĠtheĠfinalĠtermĠshouldĠbe:Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(BoolĠÂ·Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(Î»x:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠÂ·ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠÂ·Ġy))ĠÂ·Ġz))ĠÂ·Ġy.ĊĊWait,Ġno,ĠmaybeĠI'mĠcomplicatingĠit.ĠLetĠmeĠsee.ĊĊAlternatively,ĠtheĠfunctionĠcanĠbeĠwrittenĠasĠÎ»A:ĠInt.ĠÎ»B:ĠBool.ĠÎ»C:ĠInt.ĠB.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠisĠ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(BoolĠÂ·Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(Î»x:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠÂ·ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠyĠ))ĠÂ·Ġz)ĠÂ·Ġy).ĊĊWait,ĠbutĠIĠthinkĠI'mĠovercomplicating.ĠMaybeĠjustĠ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(BoolĠÂ·Ġ(IntĠÂ·ĠÎ»x:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠÂ·ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠÂ·Ġy))ĠÂ·Ġz)ĠÂ·ĠyĠisĠtheĠwayĠtoĠgo.ĊĊI'mĠaĠbitĠconfusedĠaboutĠtheĠcorrectĠwayĠtoĠstructureĠthisĠwithĠnestedĠlambdas.ĠMaybeĠIĠshouldĠcheckĠtheĠprecedenceĠandĠassociativity.ĊĊInĠlambdaĠcalculus,ĠapplicationĠisĠleft-associative,ĠsoĠfĠxĠyĠisĠ((fĠx)Ġy).ĠSo,ĠtheĠfunctionĠfĠisĠexpectingĠthreeĠarguments,ĠeachĠoneĠbeingĠpassedĠsequentially.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠfunctionĠbodyĠwouldĠbe:Ġ(lamx:ĠIntĠ.Ġ(lamy:ĠBoolĠ.Ġ(lamz:ĠIntĠ.Ġy)))ĠxĠyĠz.ĊĊWait,Ġno,ĠvariablesĠareĠboundĠwhenĠtheĠlambdaĠisĠapplied.ĠSo,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbe:Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(BoolĠÂ·Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(Î»x:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠÂ·ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠÂ·Ġy))ĠÂ·Ġz)ĠÂ·Ġy).ĊĊButĠIĠthinkĠtheĠcorrectĠwayĠisĠtoĠhaveĠtheĠfunctionĠfĠtakeĠthreeĠarguments,ĠandĠthenĠreturnĠtheĠsecondĠone.ĠSo,ĠinĠtheĠterm,Ġit'sĠwrittenĠasĠfĠxĠyĠz,ĠbutĠsinceĠit'sĠcurried,Ġit'sĠfĠxĠyĠappliedĠtoĠz?ĠOrĠmaybeĠfĠxĠisĠappliedĠtoĠy,ĠthenĠtoĠz?ĊĊWait,ĠI'mĠgettingĠconfused.ĠMaybeĠIĠshouldĠthinkĠofĠtheĠfunctionĠasĠaĠseriesĠofĠnestedĠfunctions.ĊĊSo,ĠfĠisĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠanĠIntĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠaĠBoolĠandĠreturnsĠaĠfunctionĠthatĠtakesĠanĠIntĠandĠreturnsĠaĠBool.ĊĊSo,ĠtheĠtermĠwouldĠbe:Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(BoolĠÂ·Ġ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(Î»x:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠÂ·ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠÂ·Ġy))ĠÂ·Ġz)ĠÂ·Ġy).ĊĊAlternatively,ĠmaybeĠit'sĠsimplerĠtoĠwriteĠitĠasĠ(IntĠÂ·Ġ(BoolĠÂ·Ġ(IntĠÂ·ĠÎ»x:ĠIntĠÂ·ĠÎ»y:ĠBoolĠÂ·ĠÎ»z:ĠIntĠÂ·Ġy))ĠÂ·Ġz)ĠÂ·Ġy.ĊĊButĠI'mĠnotĠentirelyĠsureĠaboutĠtheĠcorrectĠplacementĠofĠtheĠvariablesĠandĠtheĠparentheses.ĊĊWa
